_meta.scope: David's REAL, recurring league — the 11 managers in `managers` below, profiled from league_intel_2025-26.md (three seasons of standings, boards, moves). These are NOT mock-draft opponents.
_meta.mock_names_directive: Owner directive 2026-08-25: random mock-draft opponent names (e.g. Mark, Luis, Pao in a one-off Yahoo mock recap) are DISPOSABLE strangers David will almost never face again. NEVER add them to `managers` and NEVER merge their individual tendencies here. A mock's only durable, transferable signal is the generic market/ADP price (where players slide vs value) and rough draft flow — not who took what.
_meta.source: league_intel_2025-26.md §5/§9/§10/§11/§12 — three seasons of standings, boards, moves; reach indices quantitative for 2025-26 (frozen Oct-2025 pool), qualitative otherwise
_meta.consumers: E18: deck mock cast (named opponents, shuffled seats) + LIVE-mode per-seat survival projection
_meta.params: adp_w = weight on market/ADP board when picking; val_w = weight on 9-cat value; noise = pick randomness (sd in board ranks); pos_bias = per-family multiplier on candidate scores; streamer = in-season churn (draft floor matters less)
_meta.loyalty: named manager-player pairs only (league-wide repetition is AT chance: 28 pair-repeats vs 30.4 expected); boosts apply per report_2026-08-04_manager_profiles.md
_meta.e18_calibration: E18a shipped 2026-08-04 (named room, findings_2026-08-04_e18_named_room.md); E18b noise model shipped same day (findings_2026-08-04_e18b_noise_model.md): owner-reported realism defect (SGA past pick 7 in 20% of rooms under flat additive rank noise) fixed with log-normal rank noise (rank x exp(N(0, noise/50))) and proportional availability (x1+(1-av)*0.35, streamers 0.15). 8-variant sweep, 300 realism rooms + 60 reach rooms per cell. Final gates ALL PASS: P(market-top-2 alive at pick 5)=0, P(market-top-4 alive at pick 8)=0, off-book R1 picks 0.9%, scaled reach band 10/10 (Noah excluded per owner correction - his -43.5 is autodraft board geometry, kept as the seat-free geometry reference), Spearman 0.952, P(Robby drafts Jarrett Allen)=0.77. Absolute reach band still re-arms at the October real-ADP sync.
